purpose: Internal optional SQL snapshot-root primitive. It supplies a readonly scope, NOT source admission, host authorization or an alternative business read API.
producer: Existing openLocalStore; existing operation(true), queue, BEGIN IMMEDIATE and SQLite connection. No second store or new mutable transaction semantics.

consumer.sequence: Retain canonical persistence.transaction('dashboard', original callback, options) as run. If capability exists, await readSnapshotRoot.call(persistence, run, options); otherwise await run(). Root resolution, including poison/readers/abort rejection, precedes existing final egress fence.
consumer.unchanged: Pin readSnapshotRoot identity along with transaction/currentSnapshots, host/request/context/incoming. Preserve all currentSnapshots observations, callback count checks, nested joining, final host revalidation and no external awaited callback after root resolution.

wrappers.forwarding: Add optional capability to input/output Pick and forward only when underlying adapter supports it. Forwarding opens scope only. Consumer always executes wrapper.transaction inside it.
wrappers.admission: Dashboard requireSourceIdentities and guard creation remain in the exact canonical transaction. Every nested surface transaction retains its own guards. Do not require all three source metadata unconditionally: partial metadata is admissible when old flow never observes that surface.
wrappers.current_choice: Source(Fence(LocalStore)) and direct Fence(LocalStore) preserve track/authorizeSnapshot/publication because the consumer ALWAYS invokes canonical transaction. Never invoke work directly as a replacement for wrapper.transaction.
wrappers.authority: Internal scope/currentSnapshots do not authorize business access. No endpoint exposes the primitive; all59 business integration uses original transactions and host fences.

semantics.callback: Once, after all three fresh SQL observations/validation in existing dashboard,planner,procurement order; no snapshot/blob argument and no commit result.
semantics.scope: Root only. Nested calls reject through operation(true), poison the enclosing root even if swallowed, and allocate no new SQL root/memo budget. readPortfolioSnapshot joins only its existing matching own scope.
semantics.copies: All surfaces stay private. Only initial-memo-hit immutable plans get fresh factories, including Dashboard. Misses keep validated private graphs and defensive clones. Each nested transaction/currentSnapshots returns an independent graph. Mutating detached copies is allowed and never becomes stored or shared state.
semantics.writes: Nested transaction commit:true, transactionAll, blob put/remove and secrets put/take/remove reject and poison, including swallowed failures. All other existing direct write operations continue through operation(true). No COMMIT in new root.
semantics.lifetime: Existing requireScope/parent signal fences and reader counter. Root closes and clears its private snapshots/copy references in finally; final signal, poison and unjoined-reader checks must pass before success. Captured descendants remain invalid; dispose drains admitted operations and refuses new admissions.
semantics.data: Retain v1 codec/validation, getter/prototype/cycle/error behavior of mutable paths. No projection of opaque C08 callbacks and no target substitution.
semantics.fallback: Absent capability executes the old transaction path. Do not claim that legacy/custom adapters acquire new atomicity/readonly semantics.

memory.shared: At most three materialization plans and 8,388,608 UTF-16 string units (16MiB string content)
memory.root: Only initial memo hits captured; at most one additional initial-memo string budget across eviction. No nested root. New root clears private graph/getter and copy references at close.
memory.limits: Not a bound on heap, decoded graphs, temporary allocations or copies retained by callers. Existing 128 depth/200000 nodes/4096 undefined-path optimization thresholds and fallback remain.

qualification.composition: Real SQLite + canonical createCurrentChoiceFence and createSfSourcePersistence, not mock guard replacements

qualification.P03: Only after safe material work reduction. Original file, 72 assertions/order/full fixture and 180000ms unchanged; one justified attempt, no promise of PASS.
